'''Sakiko Tamagawa''' (Japanese: '''玉川砂記子''' ''Tamagawa Sakiko'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tamagawa was born on January 20, 1962 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Tamagawa's only role in {{aniseries|PTS}} is that of recurring character {{jo|Liza}}.
